name: walmart_product_camoufox
description: Walmart US product page. Walmart's markup is React-rendered and rotates class names — selectors target stable data-testid/itemprop hooks, self_heal on for drift. price reads the last currency-marked number in the microdata node: the live value is rendered as 'Now $199.00', and any savings/was label precedes the current price. rating is anchored on its parentheses because the node also carries the review count ('(4.4)|44.4K ratings'), where the same digits appear twice; a whole-number rating would return null. KNOWN GAP: availability came back null on 1 of 2 live captures 2026-07-26 (measured on Camoufox, this preset's only engine before the 2026-08-27 split) and is not addressed here. ENGINE: Camoufox, fingerprint_profile=windows_on_host — a Windows claim over this host's real AMD GPU vendor. Windows rather than the honest Linux because measurement put an honest Linux claim at 15 and 23 retries against 1 and 8 for Windows (see src/browser/fingerprint_profile.py). MEASURED 2026-08-27 (2 runs per engine, 4 runs in total on the one locale this preset has, research/preset_audit_dual_engine_2026_08_27.json): both variants returned data on 2/2 runs with price 125.0 every time, and availability filled on all four — the 2026-07-26 null above did not reproduce. PREFER walmart_product_chromium: run 1 of this variant announced locale es-US and Walmart served the Spanish page (title '(Caja Abierta) Apple,AirPods Pro…', availability 'Agregar al carrito'), where Chromium takes its locale from the proxy country and announced en-US on both runs. No value was corrupted, but a consumer matching availability == 'Add to cart' or keying a cache on the title breaks on that run with nothing in the response to explain why. The evidence is one Spanish draw in two runs here; n=2 cannot say whether that is half the time or rare. MEASURED 2026-08-28 (retest of the same twenty presets through the same harness after the five audit fixes; n=2 per locale, 92 runs, research/preset_audit_dual_engine_2026_08_28.json): 2/2 runs returned data with every declared field filled. THE SPANISH-PAGE DRAW IS GONE: both runs announced en-US, where 08-27 drew es-US on one of two and Walmart served that run a Spanish page to a US-locale preset. Across the whole 08-28 record no Camoufox run announced a language its geo_profile table does not give for the region it exited through (0 of 45 that reported a locale, against 11 of 45 on 08-27), so this variant is no longer the odd one out against its twin here.
